about: Facts per container image digest: its vLLM version (null when unknown) with the version's class, and per-flag support. A flag status is supported or rejected; a flag not listed falls back to vllm_flags.json since against a known version, else it is unknown. features name engine paths a flag alone does not prove; a feature@smNN entry holds only on that GPU architecture, and is checked before the plain name. Learned observations and bin/drip-ai runtime probe add evidence.
